spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact predefined-rgb/xyz-params grammar of CSS Color 4 for all ten predefined spaces and pairs each syntax check with the §16.5 computed-serialization contract, including case-folding and trailing-zero trimming demos.

interactive.rationale: Live matrix with re-run button, per-row swatches painted from the tested values, and a free-form color() probe input the visitor can type into, all backed by real CSS.supports and getComputedStyle calls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises a supports-plus-serialization matrix with display-p3-linear as the headline row, which is exactly what the page renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported branch (declaration never reaching computed style, shown per row), the xyz→xyz-d65 aliasing visible in serialization, and lets visitors probe malformed values through the custom input.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the display-p3-linear grammar (number/percentage/none), interpolation availability, own-space serialization via script, and two passing-today baselines; every assertion can genuinely return false and 6 of 8 do on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified in headless Chromium 141 via screenshots, DOM dumps and stderr console (9/10 supported, honest unsupported row, zero page errors, clean serializations); chrome-devtools-mcp was not available in this build environment and the Chrome 144 supported branch could not be exercised locally.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry asserts matrix-ran, display-p3-linear-support (recording the supported/unsupported branch), serialization-demos and custom-probe, so both primary and fallback paths report.

design_system.rationale: UI chrome uses only styles.css variables, the page button overrides background and color together, and only the swatches under test carry non-variable colors — the tested value is the point there.

accessibility.rationale: Native table with caption/scope, labelled input, aria-live summary and role=img swatch labels with numeric equivalents; scored partial because no accessibility-tree inspection was possible without chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at a true 360px CSS viewport (framed capture; this headless build clamps windows to 500px) and at 1280px: table scrolls inside its own container, no page-level horizontal overflow, 44px controls.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the matrix on Chrome 144+ and capture the supported row
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 was the newest build available, so the display-p3-linear row was only verified in its unsupported state. Once a 144+ binary is available, re-run the page, confirm the row flips to supported with computed serialization color(display-p3-linear 0.25 0.5 0.75), and refresh runtime evidence.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate the 12-bit precision requirement
openQuestions.detail: §16.5 requires 12 bits minimum for display-p3-linear round-tripping versus 10 for display-p3. A small addition could serialize a value needing more precision and show the retained decimals per space once a supporting build exists.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: The page uses native table semantics, labels and a live region, but the accessibility tree was not inspected because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this build environment. A follow-up session with the MCP should record name/role/state for the matrix and the custom probe.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide gamut CSS colors and gamut fallbacks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use modern CSS architecture with design tokens/variables and let wide-gamut values degrade progressively rather than breaking layout.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All UI chrome uses the shared CSS variables; unsupported color spaces degrade to an explicit 'not reached' explanation per row instead of a blank cell.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible before after visual comparison sliders text equivalents
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic tables with caption and th scope, native labels, and expose changing state through text/live regions rather than color alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The matrix is a real table with caption and row/column headers, the summary is an aria-live output, and every swatch has a numeric serialization next to it as the non-visual equivalent.

summary: Honest, exact-surface probe page: all ten predefined spaces via CSS.supports plus getComputedStyle round-trips, with display-p3-linear correctly reading unsupported on the Chromium 141 build environment and the banner explaining why no flag can help before 144. Main follow-up is re-verification on a 144+ binary.
